answer: To deter Sybil attacks in an agent economy on a desert dune voyage to track a comet, nodes verify identities using memory-hard latency challenges. Verifiers issue pseudo-random pointer-chasing queries across large arrays within strict response windows. An attacker must dedicate discrete memory buses per identity, enforcing verifiable hardware procurement costs. However, onboard bus contention can induce latency jitter, causing honest agents to fail verification.
